decision_record_2a.transfer: Liquidity demanders pay the quoted spread; selection sorted by expiry/delta/strike distance only, and the debit was computed at the ask for a market order, so a wide-spread contract silently consumed the sleeve's small risk budget (0.5% of slice).
decision_record_2a.comparison: Control enters any contract inside the DTE/delta bands whose debit passes the premium caps. Treatment refuses when the long leg's spread exceeds 25% of its ask (pre-registered threshold, MODEL ASSUMPTION).
decision_record_2a.mechanism: Execution: an executable-spread gate at selection time; sizing, bands and caps unchanged. (Second look alongside batch-10's mid-limit pricing, which prices the fill; this gate refuses the untradeable quote.)
decision_record_2a.calculation: Decision diff is the calculation: on identical fixture inputs, control vs treatment intents are recorded in ab_fixture_drive; the leak's cost is the full position (refused entries) or the qty delta (volume cap) on opportunities whose defining condition no longer holds at decision time. No P&L figure is invented pre-forward-evidence.
decision_record_2a.experiment: Forward paper: paired shadow records (ctx/enhance_paired, exp_id ENH-EDGE-B2-<sleeve>) journal control vs treatment on every gated opportunity; reject the enhancement if, over 20 paired opportunities, refused entries would have outperformed entered ones net of the sleeve's own fee model, or if the gate refuses >50% of otherwise-valid entries (mis-calibration). Switch OFF restores the pre-change rule exactly (blocker-proven).
